info.background_text:
The foreseeing priestess.
Capable of manipulating light and occasionally glimpsing the future through foresight. She exhibits minimal emotional changes, not being overly cold or expressionless, but lacking visible sorrow or anger, which gives her an enigmatic aura. Often works alongside Quinto.
